key_concepts: Chemical properties are observed during or after a chemical reaction.
Flammability is a chemical property describing how easily a material catches fire.
Highly flammable materials can ignite and burn quickly at low temperatures.
Materials can react with oxygen in the air.
The browning of cut apple is caused by a reaction with oxygen.
Iron materials form rust when exposed to moisture and air.
Biodegradable materials break down naturally into harmless substances.
Non-biodegradable materials do not decompose easily and persist in the environment.
Plastic is an example of a non-biodegradable material.
Knowledge of chemical properties helps in solving daily problems and making decisions.
